vanilla_noise_column_cell_fill.conversion: MixinExtras @ModifyExpressionValue on the NoiseChunk NEW in NoiseBasedChunkGenerator.iterateNoiseColumn (the target method's arguments arrive as trailing handler parameters, no @Local) to mark the one-cell column NoiseChunk, and @WrapOperation on the cell-cache DensityFunction.fillArray call in NoiseChunk.selectCellYZ, which fills only the queried column's cellHeight slots when the provider is that marked NoiseChunk; a duck interface on NoiseChunk (bons$cf* names) sets its in-cell position; per-world density audit, canary and runtime flag in the helper. 1.21.1: NoiseChunk and iterateNoiseColumn unchanged; steps aside next to Generator Accelerator's and C2ME dfc's NoiseChunk rewrites (yields)
vanilla_noise_column_cell_fill.license: Minecraft (Mojang): no-copy; the mixins carry only our own logic (helper bons.furious.patch.vanilla_cellfill.ColumnCellFill)

yields.name: Generator Accelerator
yields.why: Generator Accelerator (tested 1.21.1-1.6.2) @Overwrites NoiseChunk.selectCellYZ (and fillSlice, forIndex, updateForY/X/Z) at the default priority. Mixin refuses our @WrapOperation into a method another mixin overwrote at equal priority (the class fails to load and the game stops at the first world load), and the cell fill relies on vanilla's selectCellYZ / forIndex / updateFor*, so this switch steps aside whenever that mixin is listed. Found by a scan of the other mods' mixins on the same classes for the 1.21.1 port.

yields.name: C2ME (density function compiler)
yields.why: C2ME 0.4.0-alpha.0.122's opts-dfc module @Overwrites NoiseChunk.updateForY/X/Z and swapSlices and rewires the NoiseChunk's density functions in its constructor. The cell fill's exactness relies on vanilla's updateForY/X/Z resetting the in-cell state the column fill leaves behind (C2ME's code is not read: clean room), so this switch steps aside whenever that module lists its mixin, as the port's other worldgen switches stand aside where C2ME rewrites the same code. Found by a scan of the other mods' mixins on the same classes for the 1.21.1 port.
